description: This file defines the class Structures_Graph_Node, representing a node in a graph data structure, including methods for managing node data, metadata, connections, and graph relationships.

classes.name: Structures_Graph_Node
classes.description: Represents a node in a graph, with methods for data management, metadata, and connectivity.

methods.name: getGraph
methods.description: Returns the graph to which this node belongs.

methods.name: setGraph
methods.description: Sets the graph for this node.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Retrieves the data stored in the node.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets the data for the node.

methods.name: metadataKeyExists
methods.description: Checks if a metadata key exists.

methods.name: _connectTo
methods.description: Private method to connect this node to another node.

methods.name: connectTo
methods.description: Connects this node to another node, optionally reciprocally if undirected.

methods.name: connectsTo
methods.description: Checks if this node has an arc to another node.

methods.name: inDegree
methods.description: Calculates the number of arcs entering this node.

methods.name: outDegree
methods.description: Calculates the number of arcs exiting this node.
